name: Adminstrative complex
desc: A labiryinthine network of bureaucratic offices and communication systems that allow for the centralized and efficient governing of the world, as well as acting as the seat of power for planetary governors

name: Arms dealer
desc:
An independent arms dealer that provides everything from untraceable firearms to entire ships that legally don't exist to anyone who has the credits for it, an operation of this scale can only be sustained by the cooperation with whoever runs the colony, both by providing cover from nosey inspectors and providing the necessary industrial base for producing the ''merchandise''. Of course a ''business'' like this tends to attract unsavoury customers.

The operation grows in profitaboloty and disruption the bigger the colony gets
